Business drivers: reduce per-transaction inference cost vs cloud public endpoints, predictable throughput during Black Friday-like spikes, and strict audit/KMS controls for cardholder data.
Preferred integration: VPC Private deployment with optional on-prem gateway for EU settlement nodes.

POC summary: 2-week dedicated POC ran with 4 model variants (full, quantized, truncated, reranker). Observed 28-35% token cost reduction using workload-aware batching + KV caching. See dedicated_poc_report.xlsx.

Autoscaling policy preferences discussed: scale-up aggressively on queue depth (add 2 nodes when queue > 100 requests), scale-down conservative (drain then scale down after 10m idle), maintain 4-GPU warm pool for sub-100ms cold-start risk reduction.

Queueing/backpressure: want per-tenant concurrency caps, graceful degradation to quantized model variant when queue latency > 200ms, and circuit-breaker to route to hosted fallback for non-PII workloads.
Security notes: must support customer-managed KMS and audit logs retention 7+ years for settlement audits. ISO27001 paperwork requested.
Pricing sensitivity: finance wants a blended ARR under $1M with clear reserved commit tiers; procurement pushing for a 12-month commit with scheduled review.

Observed POC telemetry: p95 latency with warm pool = 120-140ms; cold starts spiked to 600-900ms before pre-warm; batching improved throughput 30% during 90th percentile load windows.
